sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. submits that notice of the instant application has been served upon the informant and Child Welfare Committee, Budaun on 19.12.2024.
The receiving endorsements produced by the learned A.G.A. are taken on record.
However, no one appears on behalf of the said opposite parties nor any counter affidavit has been filed on their behalf.
2. Heard counsel for the applicant, Sri Neeraj Kumar Sharma, learned AGA for the State and perused the material on record.

3. This application has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Speical Sessions Trial No. 313 of 2022 and Case Crime No. 73 of 2022, under sections 363, 366, 376-D I.P.C., Sections 3(2)5 of S.C./S.T.
Act and Section 5-G/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station Dataganj, District- Budaun.

Ravendra vs State Of U.P. on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114028889/
1 4.
Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant was not named in the first information report and has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
After investigation, final report was submitted in favour of the applicant.
The applicant has been summoned on 23.05.2023 by the trial court under Section 319 Cr.P.C.
As per the ossification test report, the victim was aged 17 years.
The range of error in determining the age is about two years and the same should be read in favour of the applicant at this stage.
As per her statement in the trial court, the victim/P.W.2 was taken on a motorcycle to Budaun and, thereafter, to Delhi.
It is contended that the victim was present at public places.
She did not raise an alarm nor did she resist the applicant.
The conduct of the victim show that she was a consenting party.

It is next contended that named co-accused, Jitendra has been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 14.09.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.
35130 of 2022 (Jitendra vs. State of U.P. and 3 others).

entities.text:
Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.
35130 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant claims parity.
Investigation has been completed.
The applicant had cooperated in the investigation.
No custodial interrogation is required.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents.
The applicant has apprehension of his arrest in the above mentioned case.
In case, the applicant is released on anticipatory bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.

6. Having regard to the submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant, considering the nature of accusations, antecedents of the applicant and the fact that the applicant was not named in the first information report.
As per the ossification test report, the victim was aged 17 years.
The victim was present at public places.
She did not raise an alarm nor did she resist the applicant.
Co-accused, Jitendra has been granted bail by this Court.
At this stage, there is no substantive evidence against the applicant.

The applicant had cooperated in the investigation and no custodial interrogation is required, without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

2 8.
In default of any of the conditions, the court concerned is at liberty to pass appropriate orders for enforcing and compelling the same.
9. The application stands disposed of.
